gallery.caption: Hudson is probably the sweetest boy you could ever meet. We had the pleasure of seeing him today for a sore paw and updating his vaccines. As you can see, Hudson is all smiles!
Baby Snoopy (Shih-tzu/Yorkie) learning to be an assistant at MAH and greeting our clients with a very friendly attitude. 12/10 was a very good boy!
These 3 beautiful frenchies are only just a couple of hours old. They are the retirement litter of this beautiful mama, Nala.
Regular checkup for our feline friends
Meet Coco and Chanel. These two beauties came in for a wellness examination, and are rescues residing with A Worthy Claws Rescue Society.
After 30 minutes of trying to revive them, they finally took their first breath. Ten puppies in total. All healthy, happy and back home with mom.
Our lovely, Kona, here for her first spa day. This beautiful girl belongs to one of our highly reputable French bulldog breeders.

These 4 french bulldog gems belong to none other than Nala. She delivered 3 boys and 1 girl on October 18 2019 via c-section. Mom and her babies are happy, healthy and absolutely perfect. Congratulations, Nala!
Our beautiful Nala was our first ever artificial insemination. She is due any day now to deliver her puppies. We can't wait to meet her babies!
A beautiful komondor puppy born via c-section on the evening of October 26, 2019. She is from a litter of 5 perfect puppies.

Callie (2 years) is another gem belonging to A Worthy Claws Rescue Society. She was rescued from terrible conditions from Alberta; and due to her previous life, she has a terrible heart condition. She is currently living her best life with her foster mom, and MAH employee, Kennedy!

This handsome boy is Thomas. He had a very difficult life until he was rescued by A Voice 4 Paws Rescue Society, and is currently staying with his loving foster. Thomas came in for an ear hematoma on his left ear (indicated by his floppy ear).
